about: The ABI (docs/support-policy.md, D-S7; docs/api-review-1.0.md, Part 1): what compiled .tsazor code calls in @tsazor/runtime. A library compiled with 1.x runs on every later 1.y runtime, so these only grow, and a changed protocol gets a new name. packages/compiler/test/abi.test.ts pins what the compiler emits against this list and checks the runtime has each.
